_readme: Все сюжетные тексты ABYSS (версия 2: Каспий, Казахстан). Движок только показывает их. speaker → characters; on → когда запускать; goal → строка цели в HUD; tasks → чек-лист акта; dive_brief → карточка перед погружением. Порядок beats внутри акта важен. Версия 3: три языка — story.json (ru), story.kk.json, story.en.json, структура одинаковая. Поле show у каждой реплики — какая анимация-виньетка идёт на экране, пока звучит текст (CLAUDE.md, раздел 23.5). Технические поля (on, type, speaker, scene, clue, show, id) не переводятся.

world.bathyscaphe: «Nerpa» — deep-sea submersible (named after the Caspian seal)
world.flight: Flight AQ-271, Astana — Tbilisi, 214 people on board (fictional)
world.rival: «Poseidon-2» — vessel of a private foreign company

slots.title: Not an explosion
slots.text: The flap is intact, no trace of fire. The plane did not explode in the air — it hit the water in one piece.

slots.title: A water landing
slots.text: The tail was torn off by a nearly flat impact with the water. The pilots were ditching the plane. The recorder mounts are ripped out — the boxes are nearby.

slots.title: Who hired «Poseidon»
slots.text: «Poseidon» works for «Aerostar» — the company that built this plane.

slots.title: False airspeed
slots.text: The airspeed sensors iced over. The autopilot disconnected and the instruments showed the pilots the wrong speed.

slots.title: The last minutes
slots.text: The crew fought for the aircraft to the end and put it down on the water. The last command: passengers, brace for impact.

slots.title: They knew
slots.text: A month before the flight a technician logged the sensor defect. The repair was postponed. «Aerostar» knew.

card.title: Prologue
card.subtitle: Night, 02:40. Caspian Sea, 180 km from Aktau

tasks: Answer the radio call on the bridge
Take the binoculars and look at the crash site
Walk up to the chart table

beats.speaker: aigerim
beats.text: «Tulpar», this is Aktau Maritime Rescue. Captain, sorry to wake you in the middle of the night.

beats.speaker: aigerim
beats.text: Two hours ago flight AQ-271, Astana — Tbilisi, disappeared over the Caspian. 214 people on board. The last signal came from your square.

beats.speaker: aigerim
beats.text: Rescuers are working on the surface. But for the families to learn what happened, we need the black box. It is on the seabed, almost a kilometre below you.

beats.speaker: aigerim
beats.text: The box's beacon will run for five days. Then it goes silent and finding it becomes nearly impossible. You have the only deep-sea submersible in the region.

beats.speaker: aigerim
beats.text: One more thing. «Poseidon-2» is heading for the square — a private foreign company. They say they want to help. I don't like it. Get there first, captain.

cards: Goal: find and raise the black box of flight AQ-271 before «Poseidon».
Time: the beacon runs for 120 hours. Every action costs hours.
Your role: you are the captain of «Tulpar». The officers calculate and advise — you decide.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: Captain, I'm Dana, the analyst. I've laid out on the chart where the box might be. The higher the hill of tracing paper, the more likely.

beats.speaker: erlan
beats.text: Erlan, navigator. Show me where — I'll take us around the shoals and rocks.

beats.speaker: murat
beats.text: Murat, engineer. Thirty years on the Caspian. When I say «home», we go home — no tug from Aktau will come out in a storm.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: Let's start simple: head for the highest hill and listen to the seabed with sonar. It's cheap and tells us a lot at once.

card.title: Act I · The Square
card.subtitle: Day one. Find where the plane went down

acts.goal: Find wreckage and prove it is AQ-271
tasks: Listen to the seabed with sonar
Dive where the hill is highest
Find a piece with the flight number

dive_brief.title: Dive 1
dive_brief.task: Find any piece of the plane with the flight number.
dive_brief.how: The direction finder on the left shows where the signal comes from. Debris usually lies in a trail — follow it to the main find.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: An echo! Metal nearby. See — the hills around it grew. Every measurement works like this: the map learns.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: Silence. That's an answer too: it's probably empty here, and the hills moved elsewhere.

beats.speaker: aigerim
beats.text: Captain, fishermen from Kuryk saw a flash over the water last night — northeast of the signal point. Witnesses are wrong sometimes, but not always.

beats.speaker: murat
beats.text: «Nerpa» is ready. Oxygen lasts a little over a minute — then we bring her up, with a find or without.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: I'm listening to the beacon with you. Follow the direction finder needle.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: A piece of fuselage skin! The trail goes on — stay on it.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: The signal is getting stronger. You're very close.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: The signal is fading — you're drifting off. Turn with the needle.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: It's a flap, and it has a number — AQ-271. No trace of fire. The plane didn't explode, captain. It came down in one piece.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: Empty — but we've searched part of the seabed and I've recalculated the chart. Every empty metre brings us closer to the box.

beats.speaker: erlan
beats.text: Captain, lights on the horizon. Black-and-red hull. That's «Poseidon-2».

beats.speaker: berg
beats.text: «Tulpar», this is Captain Van der Berg. We are working under contract. Let's not get in each other's way — especially you in ours.

card.title: Act II · The Storm
card.subtitle: Day two. Find the tail — that's where the boxes were mounted

acts.goal: Find the plane's tail before «Poseidon» gets ahead
acts.new_mechanic: storm (A* with weighted cells), fuel for real, decoy buoy

dive_brief.title: Dive 2
dive_brief.task: Find the tail section of the plane.
dive_brief.how: After the storm the water is murky and the current pushes you sideways. Keep to the finder needle and watch your track on the sonar screen.

beats.speaker: erlan
beats.text: A storm is coming from the southwest. The Caspian is vicious in a storm: inside it a cell costs three times as much, and the sonar goes deaf. I'm plotting a detour — look how the course changed.

beats.speaker: murat
beats.text: Captain, fuel is low. If we stall in the storm, we drift and lose a day. I'd head to Aktau to refuel. Your call.

beats.speaker: aigerim
beats.text: A border patrol boat picked up a cabin seat. By the current, the tail settled in a narrow strip. Marking it on your chart.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: «Poseidon» is diving right next to us. Their computer thinks the way mine does: it trusts the echo. Drop a decoy buoy and they'll swim to it.

beats.speaker: erlan
beats.text: It worked. «Poseidon» turned toward the buoy. We have a few hours.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: The tail. It was torn off by hitting the water almost flat. They were ditching the plane, captain. And the recorder mounts are ripped out: the boxes are somewhere close.

beats.speaker: aigerim
beats.text: We intercepted a telegram from «Poseidon» to their client. It's «Aerostar» — the company that built this plane. Why would the manufacturer want the box before the investigators?

card.title: Act III · Two Boxes
card.subtitle: Third night. The voice goes silent sooner

acts.goal: Raise both recorders: data and voice
tasks: Decide what to search for first
acts.new_mechanic: two targets: two tracing-paper maps, second timer 30 h

dive_brief.title: Canyon dive
dive_brief.how: A narrow canyon, sharp debris — every hit costs oxygen. The lights sometimes flicker. The finder picks up two beacons at once: the selected one is brighter.

beats.speaker: erlan
beats.text: Captain, a plane like this has two boxes. The orange one is data: speed, altitude, control surfaces. The other holds the pilots' voices.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: The voice recorder's battery is damaged. Its beacon will go silent in 30 hours, not a hundred. I've made two maps — switch the tracing paper between «Data / Voice».

beats.speaker: murat
beats.text: What do we look for first, captain?

options.text: The voice — it will go silent soon
The data — «Poseidon» is after it right now

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: The data is readable. The airspeed sensors iced over, the autopilot disconnected, the instruments lied to the pilots. It wasn't their fault, captain.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: In the tail compartment — a technician's folder. «Airspeed sensor defect, postpone repair». Dated a month before the flight. They knew.

beats.speaker: family
beats.text: Captain of «Tulpar», we know you're out there. Rakhmet. Please, don't give them the recording.

beats.speaker: asel
beats.text: …holding it, holding it… I don't trust the speed… We're ditching. Crew to cabin: brace for impact. Thank you for flying with us.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: She held the plane until the last second. Now we know everything.

beats.speaker: erlan
beats.text: «Poseidon» raised the box. We can't get it back. We work on the second one.

card.title: Act IV · The Truth
card.subtitle: Dawn over the Caspian. Who gets the recording

acts.goal: Decide what happens to the recording

beats.speaker: berg
beats.text: Good morning, captain. You did the impossible, honestly. «Aerostar» will pay so much for the boxes that «Tulpar» gets her refit and your crew rests for a year.

beats.speaker: murat
beats.text: The lads have families, captain. I'm just saying: it's big money. Your call.

beats.speaker: dana
beats.text: If we sell — these planes keep flying with the same sensors. I'm against it.
Who gets the recording?

options.text: The investigators — let it all be by the law
Publish it — to the families and the press

investigators.title: Truth
investigators.clipping: INVESTIGATION: CAUSE OF AQ-271 CRASH — ICED AIRSPEED SENSORS. ALL AIRCRAFT OF THIS TYPE GROUNDED FOR INSPECTION
investigators.aigerim: The families got their answer, captain. And not one of those planes will fly until the sensors are replaced. Rakhmet.

public.title: Exposure
public.clipping: AQ-271 RECORDING RELEASED: «AEROSTAR» KNEW ABOUT THE DEFECT
public.aigerim: The truth was out within a day. «Aerostar» is suing you, but it looks like they've already lost.

sell.title: Silence
sell.clipping: ONE YEAR LATER: AIRSPEED SENSORS FAIL ON ANOTHER FLIGHT. CREW LANDS THE PLANE BY A MIRACLE

lost.title: Too late
lost.clipping: «AEROSTAR»: AQ-271 RECORDER DATA IS A TRADE SECRET
lost.aigerim: The families will be in court for years, captain. We did what we could.

hud.new_fragment_toast: New find on the evidence board

hints.look: Mouse — turn your head. W A S D — walk. Shift — run.
hints.click_walk: No mouse? Click on the deck and the captain walks there.
hints.waypoint: Walk to the ◆ marker — it always shows the next step.
hints.interact: Look at an object and press E.
hints.esc: Esc — release the cursor and open the menu.

binocular_lines.speaker: erlan
binocular_lines.text: See the lights to the south? Border patrol boats. The helicopter is sweeping its searchlight — they're looking for people.

binocular_lines.speaker: erlan
binocular_lines.text: That shiny patch on the water is kerosene. The plane went down somewhere here. But the current is already scattering the debris.

binocular_lines.speaker: dana
binocular_lines.text: Captain, come down to the table. I'll show you where to look for the box.

between_dives.poseidon_watch: Through the binoculars you can see «Poseidon». Its arrow on the chart shows where it is heading.
between_dives.storm_watch: Clouds to the southwest. In a few hours the storm will be here.
